verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents an official CLI that runs non-interactively and headlessly for CI and automation (docs-42). It can create and manage projects, users, and functions, plus "other operations available through Appwrite's API" (docs-12). Its JSON config with resource arrays and `includes` (docs-13) suggests scripted, declarative project setup. However, no evidence explicitly shows the CLI defining database schema (tables, columns, indexes), configuring auth methods, or setting permissions/policies; auth methods are described as being enabled from the Console (docs-44, docs-45). Missing for 10: explicit CLI-driven schema creation, CLI configuration of auth providers/settings, CLI-managed permissions/policies, hands-on or independent corroboration of an end-to-end scripted backend bootstrap.
